name: geosoft-assetview
description: GeoSoft AssetView — Intelligent Asset Environment for Oil & Gas

scripts.dev: node backend/scripts/ensureDatabase.mjs && concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build && cp -r dist/* ../backend/public/
scripts.build:do: cd backend && npm ci && npx prisma generate && cd ../frontend && npm ci && VITE_API_URL=/api/v1 npm run build && cp -r dist/* ../backend/public/
